name: Claude Auto-Review
on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    types:
      - opened
  issue_comment:
    types:
      - created

jobs:
  claude-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Claude Review
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
        with:
          trigger_phrase: "@claude review"
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          settings: |
            {
              "project_context": "This is the Reown documentation repository using Mintlify. The documentation follows a multichain Web3 architecture with a focus on wallet connectivity and dApp integration. Key sections include: 1) Getting Started guides for developers, 2) API references for various protocols (EIP-155, EIP-1193, etc.), 3) Wallet SDK documentation, 4) DApp SDK documentation, 5) Security best practices, 6) Troubleshooting guides. Content should maintain technical accuracy while remaining accessible to both beginners and experienced developers. All documentation must align with Reown's official tone of voice as defined in the reown-tone-of-voice-extract.md file. Focus on ensuring clarity, consistency, and adherence to Web3 terminology standards.",
              "review_process": [
                "1. Check for tone of voice compliance using reown-tone-of-voice-extract.md",
                "2. Verify technical accuracy of code examples and API references",
                "3. Ensure content follows the documented architecture and multichain approach",
                "4. Validate that all links are functional and properly formatted",
                "5. Confirm that the documentation aligns with current Reown product features",
                "6. Check for completeness of explanations and absence of jargon without definition"
              ],
              "tone_of_voice_path": "reown-tone-of-voice-extract.md"
            }
